$comment: The always-on agent context budget (ported from ops#292; hds#612). Every file listed here is loaded by every agent in every session before it reads a line of code: CLAUDE.md and what it marks read-first (the North Star, the llms.txt index). It is the same list as `alwaysOn` in docs/state-surfaces.json, which keeps these files to rules, read order and pointers. maxTotalBytes is the measured size after the 2026-10-12 cleanup plus about 500 bytes of margin, not a round number. Fix a violation by moving history to an on-demand file; raising maxTotalBytes is a deliberate decision about what every future session pays for.
